name: Dagrund the Bulky

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Ravaging Blow
abilities.description: A charged heavy melee attack that deals very high physical damage. This must be blocked by the tank or dodged if you are not.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.description: The boss jumps in the air and lands dealing moderate physical damage as indicated by a red circle.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.description: After landing, the boss releases tremors that will chase all group members dealing moderate damage as indicated by red circles. Roll dodge or block the tremors to reduce the damage done.

abilities.name: Summon Bearfang Hunter
abilities.description: When changing elements, the boss will summon two Bearfang Hunters to attack the group. Kill them first to simplify the fight.

dialogue.line: Staking your claim to Lord Hircine's boon, huh? Good luck! You're going to need it with competition like us.
dialogue.trigger: Dagrund can be first encountered at the entrance to the Bloodscent Pass along with the other competitors.

dialogue.line: What makes your group so special?
dialogue.trigger: Dagrund can be first encountered at the entrance to the Bloodscent Pass along with the other competitors.

dialogue.line: "The blood of werebears runs through our veins.
dialogue.trigger: Dagrund can be first encountered at the entrance to the Bloodscent Pass along with the other competitors.

dialogue.line: You know, the cozies out there are always quick to associate Lord Hircine with werewolves. And they're fine and all, I suppose. But nothing beats a werebear's might!"
dialogue.trigger: Dagrund can be first encountered at the entrance to the Bloodscent Pass along with the other competitors.

dialogue.line: And what favor do you want to ask Hircine?
dialogue.trigger: Dagrund can be first encountered at the entrance to the Bloodscent Pass along with the other competitors.

dialogue.line: Not sure yet. Winning the Great Hunt is sure to earn us eternal glory. Any prize we earn afterward is just icing on the sweetroll.
dialogue.trigger: Dagrund can be first encountered at the entrance to the Bloodscent Pass along with the other competitors.

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Troll's blood, it has to be here somewhere! Keep an eye out!
dialogue.trigger: Dangrund can be encountered again in the Wispwood, where his group has been tracking Tarcyr and the area has become suspiciously foggy.

dialogue.speaker: Bearfang Hunter
dialogue.line: Where did he go?

dialogue.speaker: Bearfang Hunter
dialogue.line: By Kyne!
dialogue.trigger: <His corpse drops from the sky. and the rest of the hunters are teleported into the air as well.>

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Don't you see? You're the Hare now, hunter!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: It's time for the hunt to truly begin!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: I feel its power coursing through me! I feel it calling for your deaths!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: You shall join us in our eternal hunt!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: I'll strike you down!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Feel a werebear's strength!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Behold a werebear's might!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Fire and ash! I'll burn you all!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Burn beneath the flames!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Scorching heat! Smoldering flesh!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Freeze and perish!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Feel winter's wrath!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: May glacial winds take you!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Face my storm's wrath!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Lightning's might! Storm's fury!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: My storm will strike you down!

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: It seems the Great Hunt has come to an end.

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: And so your hunt has ended.

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: This grove is now your grave.

dialogue.speaker: Dagrund the Bulky
dialogue.line: Join us within the Hunting Grounds. Forever.

notes: It's not clear during the fight but according to Hanu, Tarcyr killed Dagrund and the rest of the Bearfang and puppeteered their corpses.
Though he is a werebear, he never transforms into one.
Dagrund uses the Misanthropic Lycanthrope hairstyle.
related_quests: The Great Hunt: Conquer the March of Sacrifices and emerge victorious in the Great Hunt.
Pledge: March of Sacrifices: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the March of Sacrifices.
summary: Dagrund the Bulky is a Nord who can be found in the March of Sacrifices. He is the leader of one of the groups competing in Hircine's Great Hunt and claims to be descended from werebears. Later on in the Whispwood, Tarcyr will kill him and his fellow hunters, raising him as an undead thrall.
